ticks.note: Held: `if 2 true` has counted one tick.
Released before the count is complete: `fall`, and back to `Up`. No `longPress`.
Pressed: `rise`. `Down` is entered afresh, so its count starts again.
Held: two. `if 2 true` fires in the third tick of the press: `longPress`, and the chart moves to `Held`.
Still held: `Held` waits only for the release, so `longPress` comes once per press.
